question: Classify ECG signals into normal vs. arrhythmic using a 1D Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). Pad or truncate each signal to 256 time points, use a 70/30 train-test split, and train for 50 epochs with batch size 32.

expected_output.guidelines: Per-class precision, recall, and F1 must match within +/-0.10; row and column order may differ.
Accuracy values must match within +/-0.10; row and column order may differ.
Each cell count expressed as a proportion of total test samples must be within +/-0.10 of the reference proportion; class label naming and column order may differ.
